home.title: E-DragonBoat
home.lead: Plataporma para sa mga dragon boat team: magtala ng libreng training mula sa mobile app, tingnan dito sa panel ang mga chart, GPS map, at export, at ayusin ang lineup.
home.featTraining: Training: session na in-upload mula sa app, pini-filter ayon sa koponan; may buod, table, chart (layo, bilis, SPM, DPS, paladas) at mapa ng ruta.
home.featMaps: Mapa at JPG: ruta sa mapa o satellite; puwedeng i-download ang larawan may mapa at buod (petsa, koponan, bangka, bilang ng paddlers, distansya sa m).
home.featTeam: Koponan: datos ng club at mga tungkulin (capitan, coach, paddler). Ang capitan ay puwedeng mag-edit ng pangalan at bansa, burahin ang koponan, at mag-imbita sa email. Ang coach ay pareho ang nakikita sa training at lineup, puwedeng magpalit ng tungkulin at alisin ang miyembro, pero hindi maka-imbita o i-edit ang datos ng koponan.
home.featAccount: Account: profile, password, at wika. Ang lineup ay nasa Koponan.
home.featCompetitions: Paligsahan: karera na in-upload mula sa app kapag pinindot ang Tapos; katulad ng detalye sa training (chart, mapa).

register.footerHtml: May account na? Mag-log in

account.title: Account
account.noTeamHtml: Wala kang koponan. Puwedeng gumawa sa Koponan.

sessionDetail.title: Session {id}
sessionDetail.paddlerNoteHtml: Bilang paddler makikita mo lang ang buod at mapa.
sessionDetail.deleteConfirm: Burahin ang training session? Hindi na maibabalik.
sessionDetail.headingMeta: Mga field ng training (ugat na JSON)
sessionDetail.headingSamples: Mga sample bawat segundo (lahat ng key sa bawat punto)
sessionDetail.chartForceHint: Mga tuktok bawat segundo (bar kung may sukat sa segundo na iyon).

sessions.title: Malayang training
sessions.filterHint: Ang ililista lang ay ang mga session na ang teamName sa app ay tumutugma sa pangalan ng koponang ito (hindi sensitive sa laki ng titik).
sessions.noTeamHintHtml: Walang koponan: ipinapakita ang lahat ng training mo. Gumawa mula sa menu Koponan para mag-filter.
sessions.emptyHintWithTeamHtml: Sa app, kailangan pareho ang pangalan ng koponan sa {teamName}.
sessions.emptyHintNoTeam: Mag-save ng training sa app gamit ang account na ito.
sessions.dayMapAria: Pinagsamang mapa para sa piling araw
sessions.dayMapHint: I-download ang mapa may buod ng araw (JPG).
sessions.mapNoGpsDay: Walang GPS coordinates sa mga session ng araw na iyon.
sessions.jpgExportError: Hindi na-generate ang JPG (minsan dahil sa tiles ng mapa). Maghintay matapos ang mapa bago subukan, o kumuha ng screenshot.

errors.notFoundDeploy: Hindi nahanap ang resource (404). I-upload ang na-update na app/main.py (mga ruta /api/v1/profile at DELETE /api/v1/equipo/{id}) o ang buong proyekto, pagkatapos: sudo systemctl restart edragonboat-api

teams.emptyNoTeam: You are not a member of any team yet.
teams.adminAllHint: Select the team to view and edit the roster below. Club settings (name, country, delete) are still under Settings.
teams.plantelHint: Roster data is saved on the server. Captain and coach can edit rows; captain and admin can change emails. Use Save roster to apply all changes.
teams.inviteHintHtml: You can invite by email even without an account: a user is created with password 12345678 (they should change it in Account). If the server has SMTP, they receive the login email.
teams.inviteCoachOnlyHtml: Only the captain can invite new people to the team.
teams.inviteSuccessMember: Done: they are on the team.
teams.inviteSuccessNewWithEmail: New account created and email sent with the temporary password.
teams.inviteSuccessNewNoSmtp: New account created (password 12345678). No email was sent: configure SMTP on the server.
teams.logoHint: Recommended: square 512×512 px, PNG (white or transparent background) or JPEG. It is normalized to PNG up to 512 px on a side.
teams.deleteHint: Removes the team and memberships. Uploaded training sessions are not deleted.
teams.onlyCaptainEdits: Only the captain can change the name, country, or delete the team.
teams.pickPngJpeg: Choose a PNG or JPEG file.
teams.confirmDeleteTeam: Delete this team permanently? This cannot be undone.
teams.confirmRemoveMember: Remove this person from the team?

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.emptyLead: Races recorded in the app when the distance is finished and Complete is tapped (requires API with POST /api/v1/sessions/competencia).
competitions.introGlobalHtml: Global list: competitions from all teams are shown (login required). You can open the detail only for your team’s sessions (or ones you uploaded).
competitions.emptyWhenUploaded: When someone finishes a race and uploads the session from the app, it will appear here.
competitions.mainHint: Sessions uploaded when the race ends in the app. Open one for charts, table and map (same as Training).
competitions.idLockedTitle: You can only open your team’s detail
